name: How long does it typically take to build a rental ADU from start to finish?
description: Construction usually takes 6 to 18 months, with permit approval times and design complexity being major factors affecting the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a rental ADU from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a rental ADU can range from 6 to 18 months, depending on factors like permit approval times, design complexity, and construction scheduling. Permitting is a significant variable; for example, in Berkeley or Oakland, permit processing can sometimes take several months. Gathering all necessary property documents and having a clear design plan prepared can help streamline the initial phases.
